# huggingface Provider

Manage Hugging Face Inference Endpoints via the Hugging Face Endpoints API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    huggingface = {
      source = "gorgias-oss/huggingface"
    }
  }
}

provider "huggingface" {
  host      = "https://api.endpoints.huggingface.cloud/v2/endpoint"
  namespace = "some-namespace"
  token     = ""
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) Base URL of the Hugging Face Endpoints API. Defaults to the public endpoint if omitted.
- `namespace` (String) Hugging Face namespace (user or organization) that owns the endpoints.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Hugging Face API token used to authenticate requests.
